about_the_game:
🧠 Divine Diner

Kitchen Automation × Tower Defense

In a world ruled by gods and populated by vegetable-people and animal-folk, capitalism has reached its final form. You’ve been “chosen” to cook for the divine elite. Will you serve them loyally, or secretly aid the oppressed masses exiled to the orbital slums?

🧩 Features

  • Build Your Own Kitchen Empire
    Unlock equipment, expand your workspace, and optimize production in your fully customizable sci-fi kitchen.

  • The Faster You Serve, the More You Earn
    Time is money—deliver dishes quickly to earn generous tips from your divine patrons.

  • Serve the Gods... or Defy Them
    Will you obey and prosper, or resist and smuggle resources to help humanity survive?

  • Harvest Brains, Craft Robots
    Extract neural tissue from leftover “ingredients” to create obedient robotic workers that lighten your load.

  • Keep It Clean, or Be Overrun
    Space roaches are relentless. Maintain cleanliness, or face a full-blown infestation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6xxx, AMD FX™-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750 or AMD Radeon™ R7 265
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: This is a single-player simulation and management indie game that combines kitchen automation, production pipelines, and light tower defense elements. Build your very own kitchen base and prepare the most anticipated meal for the "Gods"!
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
